decision.case_state: Stage: visit. Oven repair (main oven element not heating; grill works), routine. Landlord approved Keystone Compliance on 26 Aug ("Yes go ahead"). Provider was booked for 30/08/2025 10:00-12:00 in the system. On 30 Aug the tenant said she had arranged 8 September 2025 with the provider. The provider has not confirmed either date. Job is on hold, waiting for the provider, review 2 Sept 2025.

next_actions.action: Ask Keystone Compliance to confirm in writing the exact date and time they have booked (30/08/2025 10:00-12:00 per our record, or 8 September 2025 per the tenant), noting 30/08 is a Saturday.
Tell the tenant the date is not yet confirmed, that we are checking with the provider, and that we will write once they reply.
Hold the job until the provider confirms the date, with a review on 2025-09-02.

The cause of the fault is not established, and no quote or cost is approved beyond the landlord's general go-ahead.

Once confirmed, update the tenant and set the visit with the provider's confirmation.
Confirm the tenant's name and contact details, which conflict across records (owner: agency records).
Attachment on the provider email (event 014) is unavailable; re-request if needed.
Landlord to be updated with the visit outcome after the visit.

decision.summary: The oven repair is approved by the landlord and with Keystone Compliance, but the visit date conflicts: the system says 30/08/2025 10:00-12:00 and the tenant says 8 September 2025. I asked the provider to confirm the date in writing, told the tenant it is not yet confirmed, and put the job on hold until 2 September 2025.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: Visit stage, routine oven repair. Landlord approved Keystone Compliance on 26 Aug. The visit date is unconfirmed (30/08 in the system vs 8 Sept per the tenant). The provider's confirmation is outstanding.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Email Keystone Compliance (existing thread) to confirm the booked date and time. Email the tenant (existing thread) that the date is not confirmed. Job on hold, review 2 Sept 2025.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No. This is routine work within the approved scope. The name and contact conflicts can be settled by records checks, not a decision. Escalate only if the provider cannot confirm a date or the spend exceeds what the landlord approves.

tickets.description:
Hi there,

Hope you are well.

Apologies for bringing something to attention not long after moving in. Apart from this one small issue, everything else seems fine, and we are really enjoying the comforts of the property! :)

I am not sure if I am missing something on the fan oven. We finally managed to get around to using the oven on Tuesday evening,
(It's been a long and stressful move-in from the old place to here, so apologies for not checking this sooner).
The oven doesn't seem to heat up using the main oven section. I can confirm that the grill heating element works, as I used this last night to cook with, but the main oven heating element doesn't seem to work. On Tuesday evening, we had the oven running for at least an hour to try and get it up to 200 degrees, but it was not heating up at all.

I looked through the instruction booklet I found and am certain I am not missing anything in relation to how the oven operates.

Is this something that could be looked at, please?

Kind regards
Clara
